plain: A man named Jordan, who says he was taken into a UFO programme as a child in upstate New York, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a researcher named Puharich. Jordan says Puharich likely championed an earlier version of the same research that Jordan later went through himself. If true, it would link work going back to the 1970s with what Jordan says happened to him decades later.
